rows.wylie: bla rnal mjug rang sems bla ma'i thugs bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes su gyur par bsam tshul legs pa byung yod na, 'chi ba chos sku'i lam 'khyer gyi skabs su yang myod yul bde ba de gas chog cing, myong yul bde ba zhes pa yul la sbyar rgyu min par yul can la sbyar rgyu yin gsungs
rows.english: Remember the end of the section on the practice of the Lama, where you think that your mind has turned into the holy mind of your Lama, that wisdom of undivided bliss and emptiness.  If you have been able to do this step well, then here in the practice of using death as a path to the Dharma Body you can use that same bliss as the object that you experience.  Our Lama noted that, when we talk here about "great bliss, the object which the subject experiences," you must understand that we are actually referring to the subject which does the experiencing, and not the object it experiences.

rows.wylie: [iv.203-8] khams dang 'gro ba gang na las 'phen pa du yod cin, 'gro ba lnga po thams cad na ni las kyi 'phen pa bzhi yod, 'on kyang dmyal ba na ni dge ba'i las kyi 'phen pa gsum yod kyi, mthong chos la myong 'gyur gyi dge ba'i las 'phen med de, de na rnam smin yid du 'ong ba med pa'i phyir
rows.english: One may ask which different deeds can be projected with different realms and beings. Every one of the five different types of beings each has all four kinds of projections produced by deeds. In the hells through there are only three projections of virtuous types of deeds that are possible. Here there can be no projection of a virtuous deed that will bring one a result that he sees in the very same life, because it is impossible for any deed to ripen into a pleasant result in the hells.
rows.acip: [IV.203-8] KHAMS DANG 'GRO BA GANG NA LAS 'PHEN PA DU YOD CIN, 'GRO BA LNGA PO THAMS CAD NA NI LAS KYI 'PHEN PA BZHI YOD, 'ON KYANG DMYAL BA NA NI DGE BA'I LAS KYI 'PHEN PA GSUM YOD KYI, MTHONG CHOS LA MYONG 'GYUR GYI DGE BA'I LAS 'PHEN MED DE, DE NA RNAM SMIN YID DU 'ONG BA MED PA'I PHYIR,

rows.wylie: 'di ni rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gzhan las skye na, gzhan yin tshad thams cad las skye bar 'phen pa bzhin du rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i shes pa cig skye na, yul skra shad med par mtshungs pa la, rab rib can la de mthong ba skye la, rab rib med pa la de mthong ba mi skye ba mi 'thad de, shes pa de rab rib la mi ltos par 'phul nus pas 'brel med du 'gro ba'i phyir ro
rows.english: If something could grow from something other than it which existed through some nature of its own, then that implies that it could grow as well from each & every other object in the universe which was other than it. Just so, if it were possible for one state of mind to grow which existed through some nature of its own, then it would be incorrect to say that—in a case where the strand of hair were equally absent—the sight of it would grow in a person who had cataracts but the sight of it would not grow in a person who had no cataracts. That is, since there would be the potential for this state of mind to make itself known without any dependence upon cataracts, everything would happen without any connection to anything.
rows.acip: 'DI NI RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PA'I GZHAN LAS SKYE NA, GZHAN YIN TSAD THAMS CAD LAS SKYE BAR 'PHEN PA BZHIN DU RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PA'I SHES PA CIG SKYE NA, YUL SKRA SHAD MED PAR MTSUNGS PA LA, RAB RIB CAN LA DE MTHONG BA SKYE LA, RAB RIB MED PA LA DE MTHONG BA MI SKYE BA MI 'THAD DE, SHES PA DE RAB RIB LA MI LTOS PAR 'PHUL NUS PAS 'BREL MED DU 'GRO BA'I PHYIR RO,,

rows.english: Make a firm resolve in your mind That whenever you eat, or wear some clothes, Or enjoy the use of a place to stay, You'll always do so with constant thoughts Of wishing to reach enlightenment For the sake of others beings. And then at the end of the day, When it's time to go to bed,

rows.english: Next let's consider a realized being who is stable and has overcome desire for any one or number of the seven levels between. Neither does he perform any deed which will lead to an experience at such a level after being reborn there; what's more, he does not even perform any deed which will lead to an experience at such a level in any other life beyond the next. This is because he will never again take a birth at a level for which he has overcome desire.

rows.wylie: sa brgyad po gang las 'dod chags dang bral ba brtan pa'i byis pa, 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa der skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las mi byed de, de phyi ma la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa der mi skye ba'i phyir
rows.english: Next let's consider a child [non-Arya] who is stable and has overcome his desire for any one or number of the eight different levels. He does no deeds of the type that will lead to an experience there after being reborn at a level for which he has overcome desire. For the fact is that for his next life he will not take any rebirth at a level for which he's lost desire.
